name: Haus Michäl
beschreibung: The Haus Michäl is peacefully set on sunny Föhrenweg in Sölden within the Ötztal, safely away from busy through-traffic yet only a short stroll from the vibrant town centre. The bright holiday apartments are functionally and comfortably furnished, featuring separate bedrooms and living spaces, fully equipped kitchenettes, and private balconies offering sweeping views of the soaring Ötztal peaks. Local restaurants, bakeries, and shops are easily reached on foot. In winter, the complimentary ski bus quickly transports guests to the valley stations of the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl cable cars, granting seamless access to the world-renowned Sölden ski area and its two glaciers. In summer, high-altitude hiking paths and the trails of Bike Republic Sölden lie right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Quietly positioned apartment house on Föhrenweg in Sölden in the Ötztal with modern holiday flats and alpine mountain views.
